myth: If my income is below 5 lakh, I don't need to file an ITR.
truth: Not entirely true. You must file an ITR if you have income from foreign assets, deposited over 1 crore in bank accounts, paid over 2 lakh in electricity bills, or traveled abroad costing over 2 lakh.
fact: Filing is often mandatory regardless of income.

myth: I can claim HRA and home loan tax benefits together.
truth: You can, but only if you genuinely live in rented accommodation while your own house is in a different city (or is under construction).
fact: Both can be claimed under specific conditions.

myth: Gifts from friends and family are always tax-free.
truth: Gifts are tax-free up to 50,000 per year. Above that, they are taxable as income unless received from a defined relative (parents, siblings, spouse) or at a wedding.

myth: The new tax regime is always better.
truth: It depends on your deductions. If you claim heavy deductions like 80C, 80D, HRA, and home loan interest, the old regime might save you more.
fact: Use the calculator to compare both regimes.
